Row.Text: On its way to meet the Sultan, Dr Rizal is taken aback when traversing the bazaar and the immense variety of products. To observe it all would take a long time, a time that could be spent talking with the Sultan.
Take the time to impregnate yourself with the sounds and smells of the location.
Ask the Sultan about the logistics of the market.
The end of the world has a Date, or not

Because of reasons beyond our means (some scholars are talking about a transition), our Date Palm Plantations refuse to bear fruit this year. But hope is not lost, as we are certain that the Dates will come back.
The Date Palm Plantation will temporarly not give Dates this turn.
The Great Book of a Dynasty

A scholar was asked by the Sultan to write a great book to record his legacy and how well they ruled the land. The scholar doesn't have to lie, they can see how they turned the desert into a magnificient trading hub. But what to write? What to focus on?
It will be a detailled record of all production, inventory and trade in all the kingdom.
It will be an encyclopedia on the efficiency of different fiscal and administrative policies.
